clues: This city sits on a bay on the Pacific coast of Mexico. It is a busy port in the far northwest of the land.
A cold ocean current flows past this warm coast and shapes its year. Thanks to that cold water, late summer and early fall are its warmest times.
This city was founded in 1882. Back then, a small ranch town was made the capital of the north part of its territory.
When the United States banned strong drink, crowds of Americans came here to drink and have fun. That rush made this city a famed resort town.
Its port is the second busiest in all of Mexico. It is a key hub for trade with lands across the sea.
